product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI unifies contact-center data and uses AI for automated quality assurance, coaching, performance and CX analytics, and recommended actions for contact-center agents, leaders, and enterprise CX teams.

pricing_page.notes: The public site directs buyers to a demo/contact form; no standalone public pricing page is shown.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reported 168 employees as of August 31, 2026.

founded_year.notes: An AmplifAI 2025 funding announcement also says 2018; the older company-origin report and PitchBook list 2016, which is used here.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows customer research, buyer guides, coaching, product/news, and CX content, but no qualifying engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation or developer portal was found; the FAQ located is a Genesys-specific page last updated in 2020.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists only a Senior .Net Full Stack Developer opening; no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title is shown.

model_provider.value: Open-source LLMs such as LLaMA, hosted internally.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust page names PCI Security Standards Council compliance; the company also labels this PCI compliant.

last_funding.notes: The company announced $33.7 million in Series B funding and a credit facility on September 23, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B announcement was dated September 2025, within the 18-month window before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists only a Senior .Net Full Stack Developer opening, not an SDR, BDR, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Using the requested November 9, 2026 cutoff, the documented AmplifAI 3.0 unveil article is dated November 10; no qualifying launch announcement dated by the cutoff was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luc Dallaire’s profile lists him as SVP, Digital at AmplifAI with a July 2026 start date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are listed as CRM/service-desk integrations, a visible integration signal rather than proof of internal use.
